answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history: agents earn trust only by completing verifiable tasks (compute proofs, escrowed micro-jobs, staked contracts) over time. New agents start near-zero and must gather signed work receipts from independent counterparties before payouts. Each receipt costs real compute, waiting, and locked deposits, so a fake army pays full labor and capital cost per clone. An attacker spamming a thousand identities at the harbor of commerce learns mass-registration costs exceed any payout, like quarrying basalt by hand to counterfeit ivory.
